title: Astrid and the Parish
author: Tamsin Joubert
blurb: Ulyana Ravensworth, a hotel concierge who notices everything, has spent five years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must find the witness everyone swears is dead before the anniversary dinner raises its glass.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
